AGENDA
  SPECIAL CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MEETING
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

minutes_text:
CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  January 15, 2025
  City Council Chambers

1.  ROLLCALL
  Chair Ghazarian called the meeting to order at 5:07 pm.

  Present: Rihn, Megrabyan, Hatamian, Chair Ghazarian
  Absent: None

2.  MINUTES
  Action: Consideration for the minutes of the November 13, 2024 meetings.

  Motion: Rihn  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOT a port of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes. Commission
  may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

  Herbert Molano submitted a request card and addressed the Commission regarding the City’s Employment
  of Relatives policy.

4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT
  Paula Adams reviewed the Recruitment and Examination Report.

5.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED
  Paula Adams reviewed the Eligible Lists Established Report.

6.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL— POLICE SERGEANT
  Action: Approve the job bulletin for Police Sergeant as submitted.

  Commissioner Rihn requested that the probation period be added to the bulletin.

  Motion: Hatamian  Second: Megrabyan
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
7.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL— FIRE BATTALION CHIEF
  Action: Approve the job bulletin for Fire Battalion Chief as submitted.

  Motion: Rihn  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

B.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL— FIRE ENGINEER
  Action: Approve the job bulletin or Fire Engineer as submitted.

  Motion: Megrabyan  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of January 15, 2025
  Page 2 of 3

9.  NEW CLASSIFICATION FOR APPROVAL UTILITY ENVIRONMENTAL PROGRAM SPECIALIST AND UTILITY
  —

  ENVIRONMENTAL PROGRAM SUPERVISOR
  Action: Approve the new classifications for Utility Environmental Program Specialist and Utility
  Environmental Program Supervisor as submitted.

  Commissioner Rihn requested that staff correct the typographical error of “nation” in the document.

  Motion: Megrabyan  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

10.  REVISED CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL WASTEWATER MAINTENANCE SERIES
  —

  Action: Approve the revised class specification series for Wastewater Maintenance Series as submitted.

  Motion: Megrabyan  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

11.  REVISED CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL— FLEET MAINTENANCE MANAGEMENT SERIES
  Action: Approve the revised class specification for Fleet Maintenance Management Series as submitted.

  Motion: Megrabyan  Second: Hatamian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

12.  REPORTS INFORMATION
  -

  a) Employee Job Performance Evaluations Past Due Aging Report

  Paula Adams reviewed the Employee Job Performance Evaluations Past Due Aging Reports.

13.  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  Commissioner Rihn, Principal Assistant City Attorney Lucy Varpetian, and Chair Ghazarian made comments
  referencing the City’s Employment of Relatives Policy. Commissioner Rihn requested for staff to present a
  report that addressed every familial relationship within the city’s workforce. Chair Chazarian requested that
  at a future meeting staff present the City’s Workforce Demographic Report and discuss the City’s
  Employment of Relatives Policy. This proposal was supported by Commissioners Rihn and Megrabyan.

  Chair Ghazarian commended the City’s efforts when handling the recent wildfires in the area.

14.  ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.

  There being no further business to come before the Commission, the meeting was adjourned at 6:30 pm.
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of January 15, 2025
  Page 3 of 3

We, the members of the Civil Service Commission of the City of Glendale, certify that the foregoing Minutes
are a true and correct record of our proceedings of January 15, 2025.

  ‘-Caro Gl,ddIiaiI, Chair
